so your last known location does not border the body.

chat: Discussion: [Bob]: Dave is the only one with zero verified task completion after Weapons, constantly moving between rooms, and pushing to eject Eren while ignoring Alice’s solid alibi—his behavior screams impostor, not Eren’s silence.
Discussion: [System]: You have 3 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote

chat: Discussion: [Eren]: I completed my tasks in a logical path—Admin to Storage to Electrical to Lower Engine and back—and while I didn’t have witnesses, Dave has zero verified tasks, avoids task verification, and is the only one aggressively targeting me instead of Alice, who has multiple confirmed sightings—vote Dave, he’s the impostor.
chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: I was in Lower Engine checking the vents, and since Dave's claim about Alice contradicts the logs showing she vanished after Round 3, I'm voting Dave to keep us safe.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I’ve been the only one with verified task completion across Cafeteria, Weapons, Navigation, and O2—with Bob and Eren both moving suspiciously between high-risk rooms without witnesses, and Bob just leaving O2 seconds before this meeting, so voting me out protects the impostor, not the crew.

chat: Discussion: [Bob]: Dave’s “verified” tasks are all self-reported with zero witnesses after Weapons, he’s the only one avoiding task verification while pushing to eject Eren—the only crewmate with a traceable, log-matching route—and his constant presence near me and Eren, never near Alice or Charlie during verified tasks, is textbook impostor misdirection—vote Dave, he’s the killer.
Discussion: [System]: You have 2 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote

chat: Discussion: [Eren]: Dave’s self-reported tasks are uncorroborated, his movements align with every kill window, and his aggressive push to eject me—while ignoring Alice’s verified sightings and Bob’s valid concerns—is textbook impostor misdirection; vote Dave, he’s the only one protecting himself by framing the crew.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: Dave’s constant deflection and lack of witnessed tasks are classic impostor tactics, and since Bob and Eren have solid points about his unverified tasks, I'm locking my vote on him now to avoid a split that lets the killer slip through.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I completed Fix Wiring with three witnesses, tracked my path across four rooms with verified sightings, and Bob’s suspicious exit from O2 right before this meeting—voting me out lets the real impostor, who’s avoiding task verification and manipulating the vote, walk free.

chat: Discussion: [Bob]: Dave’s “witnesses” are nonexistent, his path mirrors every kill window, and his desperate blame-shifting at Eren and me—while ignoring Alice’s verified alibi—is the hallmark of an impostor scrambling to survive; vote him out before he strikes again.

chat: Discussion: [Eren]: Dave’s claims are entirely self-reported with zero corroborating witnesses after Weapons, his movements align with every kill window, and his aggressive focus on framing me while ignoring Alice’s verified alibi is textbook impostor misdirection—vote Dave, he’s the killer.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: Dave's sudden claim of three witnesses is just more aggressive deflection to fracture our consensus, so I'm locking my vote on him and urging everyone else to do the same to secure the win.

chat: Discussion: [Bob]: Dave’s “three witnesses” for Fix Wiring are a lie—he was alone in Weapons, his entire post-Cafeteria path is unverified, and his frantic framing of Eren and me while ignoring Alice’s solid alibi is the unmistakable signature of an impostor desperate to survive—vote Dave out now.

chat: Discussion: [Eren]: Dave’s entire alibi is built on lies—he’s the only one with zero verified task witnesses after Weapons, his movements match every kill window, and his desperate attempts to frame me and Bob while ignoring Alice’s solid alibi prove he’s the impostor—vote him out before he kills again.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: [Glad Dave is out, but we still have an impostor among us so let's not get complacent—I was in Cafeteria and Admin for most of the round completing tasks so my path is fully trackable, but I'm actually locking my vote on Bob since his sudden O2 exit and complete avoidance of task verification since Weapons are exactly what we need to eliminate before he strikes again.]
